mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auths (user_id, provider, provider_user_id, password_hash) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{passwordHash})
mapper.select: SELECT a.auth_id, a.user_id, a.provider, a.password_hash, a.last_login_at FROM auths a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.provider = 'EMAIL'
SELECT auth_id, user_id, provider, password_hash, last_login_at FROM auths WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = 'EMAIL'
